The '''Medal for Bravery''' was an award in issue by the [[Cularin Militia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Militia members who demonstrated bravery and valiance in performing their duties qualified for the award. Civilians, including [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who undertook actions on behalf of the Militia at significant personal risk were also eligible.<ref name="Lockdown on Soboll" />
